targetTexts.1: “Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
targetTexts.2: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.
targetTexts.3: I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution; Israel is defiled.
targetTexts.4: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
targetTexts.5: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.
targetTexts.6: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
targetTexts.7: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
targetTexts.8: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: Lead on, O Benjamin!
targetTexts.9: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
targetTexts.10: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
targetTexts.11: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
targetTexts.12: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
targetTexts.13: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
targetTexts.14: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.
targetTexts.15: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”
